assumption_notes.be8_size, be8_inj: Abstract fixed-width encoding assumptions over int-list bytes; concrete bounded-byte/Rust encoder refinement is separate.
assumption_notes.reject_pq_input, ek_neq, lctx_neq: Witness existence for explicit rejection and key/context counterexamples.
assumption_notes.zof_inj, jrej_inj: Idealized comparison assumptions only. Global injectivity cannot instantiate a fixed 32-byte J over its complete input domain. They do not occur in the earlier ContextBound reductions. JRejectionCountermodel demonstrates why removing all rejection-function binding assumptions invalidates the three comparison claims; it does not prove that global injectivity is necessary.
